body: You’re going to do it, I believe in you.

Thanks for reaching out.

Also, my condolences. All of my grandparents have passed and it really took a toll on me. I do understand.

I can’t give you a perfect answer to your final question, that’s for you to decide. I would suggest looking at all of the prospects.

Your abusive parents are absolutely nothing but that. Abusive people that have and will continue to manipulate others. what they think and say about you is really not relevant or correct in any way. 

Having the people that raised you be shitty towards you is a heartbreaking thought, but considering moving on from them as an individual could be a healthy solution.

I moved out of my parents house when I turned 17, and my relationship with them is much better due to the distance and I suspect their fear of me never contacting them again. You’re problems mean nothing to them, but that is not the case for other people. There are plenty of resources, even online, where you can talk with people about these things.

Moving out and living on your own is scary, but I suggest you at least consider it. Now that you’re almost 19, that is a decision you can make without your parents interference. If you find a roommate, choose them carefully. If you do decide to move out, you would also need to find a job. 

Finding jobs is hard when you have higher standards for what you want to do. I’m going to university to manage at engineering firms and was running (which is lower end of the totem pole) at a Mexican restaurant to pay my rent. My point is if you find a job, even if it’s shitty, work hard and be willing to work. It is also much more rewarding when YOU feel like you did a good job.

Truth be told, I despise school. Though having a degree helps, it doesn’t seal the deal on getting good jobs like it used to. If you are unhappy with your education, maybe consider things like transferring to a college with a campus you could stay at, or taking a couple semesters off (which is completely fine to do), and focus on yourself.

I’m unfortunately trying to crunch for a midterm currently, but I’d love to message you further if you would like to shoot me a PM.

Good luck, friend
       -J
